headline: Reserve Bank of India Announces Auction of Treasury Bills across Maturities
summary: The Reserve Bank of India announced upcoming auctions for 91-day, 182-day, and 364-day Treasury Bills, including ₹8,000 crore in 91-day issuances scheduled for November 11.
why: RBI T-bill auctions manage short-term liquidity in Indian money markets and establish short-term yield curves.

impacts.name: India 91-Day T-Bill Rate
impacts.why: Scheduled government borrowing regulates interbank rupee liquidity.
